name: AustarMetro
summary: Dialup ISP (A$24.95 unlimited) in all capital cities; successor to ISP eisa after AUSTAR acquired it; customer base transferred to Virtual Communities c. 2003, reaching iiNet in 2004.

events.details: Customer base transferred to Virtual Communities (Melbourne) after Austar wound down its ISP brands (c. 2003); iiNet then bought the AustarMetro customer base from Virtual Communities in 2004 (austarmetro -> virtual-communities -> iinet). austarmetro.com.au had previously been eisametro.com.au and eisa.com.au; by 2005 the domain resolved to iinet.

refs.label: Whirlpool (Oct 2005): 'iiNet purchased the austarmetro customer base from Virtual Communities in 2004'; austarmetro.com.au formerly eisametro.com.au / eisa.com.au
